desc: Implement Dinic max-flow/min-cut with INF larger than any possible finite cut (e.g., M*D+1).
Implement check(D) using nodes (v,i), forcing (1,i) false and (N,i) true, adding INF implication edges for monotonicity and d_v <= d_u+1, and unit cost edges for crossings.
Search D from 0 to min(K,N-1) (binary search or descending scan) and print the largest feasible D.
Validate edge cases: D=0, multi-edges, cycles, and exactly-K vs at-most-K.
